snippet.title: IDLE: Intergalactic Defense League Exterminators Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4486140/IDLE_Intergalactic_Defense_League_Exterminators/

An incremental game about blasting bugs, collecting guts, upgrading a base, and blasting more bugs!

Blast the alien threat, upgrade your base, and advance on the enemy homeworld!
